source: Sentinel-1 RTC (ESA, Microsoft Planetary Computer); NISAR GCOV i GUNW (NASA-ISRO, ASF DAAC); ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 (JAXA) do sprawdzenia

layers.name: first_year

values.1: brak zabudowy do 2026 / not built through 2026
values.15: zabudowane w 2015 r. lub wcześniej / built in 2015 or earlier

layers.legend_pl: Rok, w którym radar pierwszy raz widzi zabudowę. Najciemniej: już w 2015 r. albo wcześniej; najjaśniej: 2026 r. Bez koloru: radar nie widzi tu zabudowy do 2026 r.
layers.legend_en: Year in which radar first sees built-up land. Darkest: already in 2015 or earlier; brightest: 2026. No colour: radar sees no built-up land here through 2026.

method.classifier: gradient boosting (scikit-learn HistGradientBoosting) on Sentinel-1 VV, VH, VV/VH, spread over the summer, 3x3 and 7x7 neighbourhood means; 2026 adds NISAR HH, HV, coherence
method.labels: optical built-up map (GHSL), share >= 0.15, 2015 and 2020 only
method.normalisation: quantile matching per year on unchanged cells (long-built cores, closed forest, remote farmland)
method.out_of_sample: every cell predicted by a model that never saw its 16 x 16 cell block
method.nisar_2026: series stays Sentinel-1 only; NISAR alone must confirm steps in 2025-2026; the fused Sentinel-1 + NISAR probability of 2026 is in built_years.npz (prob_2026_fused)
method.alos_palsar_2007_2010: not joined: built-up share only, low confidence (see lband_history)

prognoza.why: wiersz prognozy liczonej od stanu z radaru jest wyłączony, bo aplikacja ma już wiersz prognozy; włącza go autor aplikacji razem z danymi z pipeline/sarnik_radar_prognoza.py --web / the forecast row is off because the app already has one; the app's author switches it on together with the data from pipeline/sarnik_radar_prognoza.py --web

krzyzowo_lata.what: Sentinel-1 classifier trained on one optical year and tested on the other, on blocks it never saw
krzyzowo_lata.criterion: pass if the block-held-out AUC is at least 0.90 both ways (train 2015 test 2020 and the reverse)

blokowa_walidacja.what: block cross-validation on 2015 and 2020 together (5 grouped folds of 16 x 16 cell blocks)

alos1_dolaczenie.what: can ALOS PALSAR 2007-2010 date first years together with Sentinel-1?
alos1_dolaczenie.criterion: ALOS PALSAR 2007-2010 joins the first-year series only if (i) at most 5% of cells built in the optical map in both 2005 and 2020 get a first year after 2010, and (ii) cells the optical map turned built 2010->2015 are dated 2011-2015 with a ratio lower bound above 2 against cells it kept open

metoda_2015_2020.what: cells the optical map turned built 2015->2020 vs cells it kept open: share radar dates as first built 2016-2020
metoda_2015_2020.criterion: pass if the lower bound of the 95% block-bootstrap interval of the ratio is above 2

decyzje_2026.what: cells with a 'nowa budowa' decision (status decyzja, Jun-Aug 2026) vs the rest of Poznań without any case: share radar dates as first built 2021-2026
decyzje_2026.criterion: pass if the lower bound of the 95% block-bootstrap interval of the ratio is above 1

prognoza_2025.what: fair version, only cells touching 2020 built-up: projected built by 2025 vs not
prognoza_2025.criterion: pass if the lower bound of the ratio in the fair version (cells touching 2020 built-up) is above 1

alos2_zgodnosc.what: agreement of the Sentinel-1 built-up map with an ALOS-2 L-band-only classifier, same year 2015-2021
alos2_zgodnosc.criterion: pass if the AUC of Sentinel-1 against ALOS-2 L-band labels is at least 0.85 in every year 2015-2021 AND the change ratio (ALOS-2 rise on cells Sentinel-1 dates 2016-2020 vs cells it never calls built) has a lower bound above 2

change.what: ALOS-2 L-band built probability rises by >= 0.2 from 2015-16 to 2020-21: cells Sentinel-1 dates 2016-2020 vs cells Sentinel-1 never calls built

nisar_2026.what: NISAR alone calls the cell built in 2026: cells Sentinel-1 alone dates 2021-2024 vs cells Sentinel-1 never calls built
nisar_2026.criterion: pass if the NISAR-only probability calls built a share of the cells Sentinel-1 dates 2021-2024 (decided without NISAR) at least 2 times the share among cells Sentinel-1 never calls built (lower bound of the ratio above 2)
nisar_2026.note: labels are optical 2020 on cells whose Sentinel-1 state did not change 2020-2026 (proxy: no optical map of 2026 exists)

stabilnosc_lat.what: radar built-up share per year (mean probability, study area) does not jump for instrumental reasons
stabilnosc_lat.criterion: pass if no year-to-year change of the radar built-up share (mean probability, study area) is larger than 3 times the optical yearly growth 2015-2020

tempo_po_2020.what: radar new built-up area per year after 2020 vs the optical growth rate 2015-2020 (study area)
tempo_po_2020.criterion: pass if the radar's mean yearly new built-up area 2021-2026 is between 1/3 and 3 times the optical yearly growth 2015-2020 (study area)

zmiana_po_2020.what: radar dates new built-up after 2020 well enough to rank places: metoda_2015_2020 and decyzje_2026 both pass
zmiana_po_2020.what_pl: Radar trafnie wskazuje rok nowej zabudowy: potwierdza zmiany z mapy optycznej 2015–2020 i decyzje o budowie z 2026 r.
zmiana_po_2020.what_en: Radar dates new built-up correctly: it confirms the optical changes 2015-2020 and the 2026 building decisions.
zmiana_po_2020.criterion: pass only if metoda_2015_2020 and decyzje_2026 both pass
